info.title: adclub.kz API
info.description: Generated from @adclub/contracts — do not edit by hand. Changes must be additive (ARCHITECTURE 7.4).

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-in with a one-time code, sessions and devices

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: The catalog for every client, guests included (no session needed)

tags.name: vehicles
tags.description: The vehicle catalog for choosing a car, for every client, guests included (no session needed)

get.summary: Active administrators (phone numbers partly hidden)

post.summary: Reset another administrator's second factor: ends their admin sessions, setup is required at next sign-in

get.summary: The action journal, newest first: who did what, over what, what changed and why; filters by period, actor, action and entity

patch.summary: Rename an option of a list attribute

requestBody.description: The names to change and the version they were read at

post.summary: Archive an option (hidden from forms and filters, values kept) or restore it

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it replaces

patch.summary: Rename an attribute, change its unit, bounds or flags; the value type never changes

requestBody.description: The fields to change and the version they were read at

post.summary: Add an option to a list attribute (at the end)

requestBody.description: The new option

put.summary: Put the options of a list attribute in a new order

requestBody.description: Every option id of the attribute in the new order

post.summary: Archive an attribute (hidden from forms and filters, values kept) or restore it

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it replaces

get.summary: Brands by name with their spellings; search by a part of any spelling, case and spaces ignored

post.summary: Create a brand with its name, other spellings and the OEM flag

requestBody.description: The new brand

patch.summary: Rename a brand, replace its other spellings or change the OEM flag

requestBody.description: The fields to change and the version they were read at

post.summary: Archive a brand (no new items get it, existing ones keep it) or restore it

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it replaces

get.summary: The whole category tree with every status, names in all languages and versions

post.summary: Create a node or a subcategory (at the end of its siblings)

requestBody.description: The new category

patch.summary: Rename a category, change its icon or compatibility flag, or move a subcategory to another node of the same kind

requestBody.description: The fields to change and the version they were read at

get.summary: The attributes of a category with their options, every status included

post.summary: Add an attribute to a subcategory (number, list, yes/no or text); items of the category get an empty value

requestBody.description: The new attribute

put.summary: Put the attributes of a category in a new order

requestBody.description: Every attribute id of the category in the new order

get.summary: The bulk fill table: items of a subcategory by its active attributes, newest first, optionally only those where one attribute is empty

put.summary: Change many cells of the bulk fill table at once: all or none, a cell changed by someone else since it was read is a conflict

requestBody.description: The cells with the values they were read with

post.summary: Hide, archive or restore a category; a hidden or archived node hides its subcategories from clients

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it replaces

put.summary: Put the subcategories of a node, or the nodes of a kind, in a new order

requestBody.description: The siblings and every one of their ids in the new order

patch.summary: Change the conditions or the grounds of an approved record

requestBody.description: What changes

post.summary: Remove an approved record: it stops counting and stays as history

requestBody.description: The version it is removed from

get.summary: Items of the catalog, newest first: search by a part of the normalized article or of a name in any language; filters by category, brand, type, status and completeness

post.summary: Create a part, a product described by attributes, or a service; a duplicate is refused with a link to the existing item

requestBody.description: The new item and its values

get.summary: The item card: the item, the active attributes of its category with its values (empty ones explicit) and its analogs

patch.summary: Change the category (of the same kind), brand, article or names of an item; its type never changes

requestBody.description: The fields to change and the version they were read at

post.summary: Link two parts of one subcategory as analogs of each other (a link that exists changes nothing)

requestBody.description: The analog

delete.summary: Remove the analog link between two items

get.summary: The compatibility of an item: approved records (archived ones on request) and proposals waiting for review

post.summary: Add an approved compatibility record to a part or a product: a make and, optionally, finer levels and years, with its grounds

requestBody.description: The conditions and grounds

post.summary: Copy the approved compatibility records of an analog onto the item in one action; records it already has are skipped

requestBody.description: The analog to copy from

get.summary: Photos of an item with their source and status, approved ones in their order first

post.summary: Upload a picture for an item: the body is the file itself, checked by its content and not by its name; it is stored stripped of camera metadata and waits for approval

requestBody.description: The picture itself (JPEG, PNG or WebP)

200.description: The item already has this very picture; nothing was stored twice

201.description: The photo was stored and waits for approval

post.summary: Approve, reject (with a reason) or remove a photo; removing or rejecting the primary one hands the role to the next approved photo

requestBody.description: The new status, the version it was read at and a reason for a refusal

put.summary: Put the approved photos of an item in order; the first one becomes the primary photo shown in lists

requestBody.description: Every approved photo of the item exactly once, the primary one first

post.summary: Make an item a draft, active or archived; there is no deletion

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it replaces

put.summary: Set or empty attribute values of an item, all or none, with the refused ones listed

requestBody.description: The values and the version of the item they were read at

get.summary: The moderation queue of compatibility proposals (pending by default), oldest first, with the item, the company and whether an equal record is already approved

post.summary: Approve a proposal as it is or with corrected conditions: it becomes an approved record (an equal approved record is reused, never duplicated)

requestBody.description: Corrections, if any

post.summary: Reject a proposal with the reason the supplier sees

requestBody.description: The reason

get.summary: Every setting by group: description, type, unit, limits, default, current value, version, who changed it last and whether the API may change it

put.summary: Change one setting with a reason, from the version it was read at; takes effect in every process within 30 seconds

requestBody.description: The new value, the version it replaces and the reason

200.description: The setting now and the change

get.summary: Changes of one setting, newest first: who, when, was, now, why

post.summary: Return one setting to its default, with a reason

requestBody.description: The version it replaces and the reason

200.description: The setting now and the change

post.summary: A new set of the administrator's own backup codes; the previous set stops working

requestBody.description: The current code from the authenticator app

get.summary: What waits for a translation or is out of date, filtered by kind of entity, language and state: the volume of work, with counts by state

200.description: A page of what is waiting

get.summary: The translations of one entity by field and language: text, source (Russian, AI, manual), whether the Russian text changed since, the model and time of an automatic one, a pending task

put.summary: Write a translation by hand: it is marked as manually edited and automatic translation never overwrites it; checked like any name, a neighbour's name is refused

requestBody.description: The text

post.summary: Release a manual edit: the text stays until the automatic translation replaces it, and the language is queued for translation
Translate again: only for an automatic text, a missing one or one refused before; a manually edited text is refused (TRANSLATION_MANUALLY_EDITED)

get.summary: Engines by code with their fuel, displacement and power; search by a part of any spelling

post.summary: Create an engine: a code unique among all engines, fuel, displacement and power

requestBody.description: The new engine

patch.summary: Change an engine's code, spellings, fuel, displacement or power

requestBody.description: What changes, with the version it was made from

post.summary: Archive or restore an engine; an archived one is not offered for new modifications

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it was decided from

get.summary: Generations with their model and make, filtered by make, model, a year they cover, status and name

post.summary: Create a generation of a model with its years (no end: still made)

requestBody.description: The new generation

patch.summary: Rename a generation, change its years (they must still cover its modifications) or move it to another model

requestBody.description: What changes, with the version it was made from

post.summary: Archive or restore a generation; one of an archived model cannot be restored

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it was decided from

get.summary: The import file template: columns with descriptions and examples, the reference list values a file may name, and the CSV itself
The history of imports with their reports and results, newest first

post.summary: Upload a file to import: the body is the file itself, checked by its content; its rows are checked by a background job and nothing changes until the report is confirmed

requestBody.description: The file itself: a CSV table in UTF-8, comma, semicolon or tab separated

get.summary: An import: its state, the report before applying and the result

post.summary: Confirm the report and apply the import (a background job); only a ready import is applied, and only once
Decline an import before it is applied; nothing changes

get.summary: Rows of an import in file order with what was planned and what applying did, filtered by either
Makes by name with their spellings; search by a part of any spelling, case and spaces ignored

post.summary: Create a make with its name and other spellings

requestBody.description: The new make

patch.summary: Rename a make or replace its other spellings

requestBody.description: What changes, with the version it was made from

post.summary: Archive or restore a make; an archived make hides its models from clients

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it was decided from

get.summary: Models by name with their make, filtered by make, status and a part of any spelling

post.summary: Create a model of a make; name and spellings are unique within the make

requestBody.description: The new model

patch.summary: Rename a model, replace its spellings or move it (with its generations) to another make

requestBody.description: What changes, with the version it was made from

post.summary: Archive or restore a model; a model of an archived make cannot be restored

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it was decided from

get.summary: Modifications, newest first, filtered by make, model, generation, engine, a year they cover, market, source and status

post.summary: Create a modification of a generation: body, engine, transmission, drive, years within the generation's, market

requestBody.description: The new modification

patch.summary: Change a modification's values, years, market or generation

requestBody.description: What changes, with the version it was made from

post.summary: Archive or restore a modification; one of an archived generation cannot be restored

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it was decided from

get.summary: The reference lists of the vehicle catalog (body, transmission, drive, fuel) with every status and names in all languages

post.summary: Add an option to a reference list: a stable code and names written by hand (Russian required)

requestBody.description: The new option

patch.summary: Rename an option in any language; the code and kind never change

requestBody.description: What changes, with the version it was made from

post.summary: Archive or restore an option; an archived one is not offered for new modifications and stays where it was chosen

requestBody.description: The new status and the version it was decided from

post.summary: Send a one-time login code to a Kazakhstan mobile number (WhatsApp, SMS as fallback)

requestBody.description: Phone number and optional channel

post.summary: Check a login code; a correct code confirms the phone number and is spent

requestBody.description: Phone number and the code

post.summary: End the current session

get.summary: The signed-in account and the current session

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token (body for the mobile app, HttpOnly cookie for web clients) for a new token pair

requestBody.description: The refresh token (mobile), or an empty object (web, cookie)

get.summary: Active sessions (devices) of the signed-in account

delete.summary: End one of the account's own sessions; someone else's session answers like a missing one (404)

post.summary: End every session of the account, the current one included
End every session of the account except the current one
Finish a supplier cabinet sign-in by choosing one of the companies the number is an active employee of

requestBody.description: The sign-in step from SUPPLIER_SELECTION_REQUIRED and the chosen company; the step cookie of that response is required

200.description: Signed in; the refresh token is in the HttpOnly cookie

post.summary: Finish an admin panel sign-in with the authenticator code or an unused backup code

requestBody.description: The sign-in step and exactly one of the two codes; the step cookie of the TOTP_REQUIRED response is required

200.description: Signed in; the refresh token is in the HttpOnly cookie

post.summary: Get the authenticator app data (QR content and secret) during the setup step

requestBody.description: The sign-in step from TOTP_SETUP_REQUIRED; the step cookie of that response is required

post.summary: Confirm the authenticator app with its current code; returns the admin session and the backup codes (once)

requestBody.description: The sign-in step and the current code from the app; the step cookie is required

200.description: Signed in; the refresh token is in the HttpOnly cookie

post.summary: Switch the current cabinet session to another company the employee is an active member of

requestBody.description: The company to work for

200.description: The session now works for that company

get.summary: Companies the signed-in employee is an active member of (to switch between them)
The active category tree (goods, then services) in the language of the request; open to guests, cacheable for a minute
What the forms and filters of an active category are made of: its active attributes with types, units, bounds and options; hidden, archived and missing categories answer 404 alike

post.summary: The compatibility of items (by ids, or a whole subcategory) with a car, complete or partly known: the result, missing levels, whether a list shows the item and whether it needs a warning; open to guests

requestBody.description: The car and the items

get.summary: Liveness: answers while the API process is up
Minimum supported client version per platform and the update message
Readiness: state of PostgreSQL, Redis and S3

503.description: At least one dependency is down

post.summary: Propose a compatibility record for an active part or product with its grounds; it changes nothing for users until an administrator approves it

requestBody.description: The conditions and grounds

get.summary: A company by id — only the session's own; any other answers like a missing one (404)
The company the cabinet session works for
The own compatibility proposals of the company and their state, newest first
One proposal of the company; one of another company answers like a missing one (404)
Active modifications of an active generation (body, engine, transmission, drive, years, market) with the reference list names in the language of the request, Russian as the fallback
Active makes by name for choosing a car step by step; open to guests, cacheable for a minute
Active models of an active make by name; an archived, missing or malformed make answers 404 alike
Active generations of an active model with their years, newest first; 404 when the model or its make is archived or missing

sessionAccessToken.description: Access token of an active session (`SessionTokens.accessToken`). Expired: `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED` — refresh and repeat; `AUTH_REQUIRED` or `SESSION_ENDED` — sign in again.

ClientHeader.name: X-Client
ClientHeader.description: Client platform and version: `mobile/<version> (ios|android)`, `supplier-web/<version>` or `admin-web/<version>`. Missing or malformed values are accepted and treated as an unknown client.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Preferred language for server-provided texts: kk, ru or en (default ru).

Error.description: Any failure, in the unified error format. `RATE_LIMITED` (429) also sets `Retry-After`; `details` is `RateLimitedDetails`

ClientUpdateRequired.description: The client's version is below the supported minimum: code `CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED`, `details` is `ClientUpdateRequiredDetails`
